authority: This JSON is authoritative. The Markdown twin is explanatory and cannot weaken it.
purpose: Give preregistered candidate 13 atr_shock_snapback_4h two unchanged side identities on three unopened folds without reading or reusing viewed outcome evidence.

frozen_source.allowed_change: bind each unchanged side to causal PIT CORE-20, fold-start exchange filters, sparse causal availability, next-open signal/time fills and the frozen isolated marked-equity book

identity_and_multiplicity.rule: Register both causal_v3 side identities before market rows are read; retain both and every prior tested candidate or rejection in the full program ledger. A failed side is parked without rescue, pruning or tuning.
identity_and_multiplicity.inference: Report raw and Holm-adjusted inference for the complete frozen family as selection-bias diagnostics only; missing prior p-values equal 1.0; inference is never a promotion gate.

signal.trend: At both the preceding shock candle close d-1 and recovery decision close d: EMA50 > EMA200 for long; EMA50 < EMA200 for short.
signal.volume: volume[d] >= 0.80 * median(volume[d-42:d]); the current bar is excluded from the 42 completed prior bars.
signal.cost_distance: 1.5*ATR14[d]/close[d] >= 5*2*(0.0005+0.0002). This base identity formula is unchanged in every cost-stress replay.
signal.indicators: EMA20, EMA50, EMA200 and Wilder ATR14 use only completed causal 4h candles in the current contiguous segment and are finite at d; no entry-bar value is read.

pit_and_archive_authority.core20_derivation: For every decision d use the unique greatest validated weekly monday_ms <= decision close, then the first 20 filter-eligible crypto members in artifact order. No current, static, union, later-week or survivor-only membership is allowed.
pit_and_archive_authority.pre_market_validation: Before opening any candle, mark, funding or outcome row, verify contract, universe, manifest, classes and exchange-filter bytes and canonical content digests; validate all PIT weeks, archive schema/source/survivor flag and frozen fold bindings. Any mismatch refuses before market data.

exchange_filter_authority.selection: For each fold select the newest listed raw Binance USD-M exchangeInfo snapshot whose archive capture and payload serverTime are both strictly before fold start; freeze it for the whole fold.
exchange_filter_authority.rules: Require one complete positive PRICE_FILTER.tickSize, MARKET_LOT_SIZE stepSize/minQty/maxQty and MIN_NOTIONAL.notional for each member. LOT_SIZE is not a substitute. Duplicate, absent, non-finite, zero or negative rules make the candidate cell INCOMPLETE before any market row is read.
exchange_filter_authority.membership: Pin the PIT cell active at fold start and every later Monday strictly before fold end; take the first 20 TRADING PERPETUAL USDT COIN members passing the frozen snapshot and preserve PIT ranking order. Fewer than 20 is INCOMPLETE before market reads.
exchange_filter_authority.paper_parity: Current PAPER/testnet admission must independently pass current exchangeInfo parity; this research authority grants no runtime eligibility.

sparse_availability.decision_eligibility: At completed decision d, test a PIT CORE-20 member only from finite actually observed canonical candles in the current contiguous segment sufficient for every frozen signal input through d. Availability for every input must be <= decision close.
sparse_availability.no_imputation: Never forward-fill, backfill, interpolate, synthesize, compress time, bridge a missing canonical candle or borrow a later value for membership, OHLCV, indicators, marks, funding, fills or exchange rules.
sparse_availability.segment_indicators: Split each symbol tape at every missing or non-finite canonical 4h candle. Reinitialize EMA20/50/200, Wilder ATR14 and shifted prior-42-volume median inside each maximal contiguous segment; no indicator may bridge a gap.
sparse_availability.flat_missing_is_harmless: While flat, missing or insufficient local inputs make only that symbol non-signalling at that decision; they do not make the cell incomplete, remove it from future PIT priority or alter another symbol.
sparse_availability.no_future_veto: Full-fold coverage, later candles, later funding, current exchange status, delisting knowledge and archive tail length may not veto, approve or reprioritize a decision.
sparse_availability.exposure_fail_closed: Once a valid signal schedules an entry, every required next open, filter and fill and, after admission, every bar, causal mark, funding settlement, protection input and exit fill through final close must exist, be checksum-bound and causal. Any gap makes the entire side cell INCOMPLETE_CANDIDATE; it is never a skipped trade, dropped episode or reduced denominator.
sparse_availability.terminal_series: Observed data ending is not proof of delisting. No synthetic close, last-mark settlement, zero, bankruptcy or inferred delisting exit is allowed without a prior checksum-bound authority specifying the exact event and executable settlement. This contract supplies none.
sparse_availability.audit: Report every decision, PIT member count, non-signalling local gaps, admitted signals and exposure-critical failures by fold; preserve zero-signal decisions in frequency denominators.

execution.event_timeline: Complete the intrabar path for positions already open on decision candle d. Only a position still open at d close can schedule a signal/time exit. At next open t settle funding_time < t, freeze causal marks and Cairo day roll, execute due signal/time exits, apply re-entry locks, attempt entries in frozen PIT order, settle funding_time == t, then process fill-bar intrabar management. A due open exit wins over fill-bar gap-stop classification.
execution.reentry_lock: Candidate cell + symbol + side. A signal/time exit maps to its scheduling decision candle; an intrabar final exit maps to its fill candle. Block entry decisions at or before that associated decision open; the following completed candle is eligible. Unknown ordering or exit identity is INCOMPLETE_CANDIDATE.

intrabar_rule.gap_stop: If open is at or beyond stop, close all remaining quantity at open before any favourable event.
intrabar_rule.stop_precedence: If the stop frozen at bar open is inside the bar range, stop wins and favourable exits are suppressed.
intrabar_rule.partial_and_breakeven: Otherwise fire levels in declared path order. TP1 closes a step-floored half once; breakeven ratchets only after the completed favourable leg and can be hit only on a later adverse leg.

management.entry_atr: ATR14 at completed decision d, finite and positive
management.quantity: qty_raw=risk_cash/R_price; apply leverage cap, then floor to frozen MARKET_LOT_SIZE step. Skip the entry rather than round up if minQty or minNotional fails; maxQty excess refuses the entire side cell rather than clipping.
management.tp1_quantity: At first 0.8R touch request current_qty*0.5 and floor to MARKET_LOT_SIZE. If the result is zero, send nothing, do not mark TP1 complete and retry on a later candle. After a fill floor remaining quantity to the same step.
management.tp1_dust: TP1 has no automatic dust-to-full-close conversion. Full exits close all remaining model quantity.

book_and_sizing.entry_attempt_phase: At open t, after funding_time<t settlements, causal marks, Cairo roll and every due signal/time exit, calculate terms sequentially before this entry fill. Earlier same-open entries reduce later equity by entry fee and slippage. Funding_time==t and intrabar management occur only after all entry attempts.
book_and_sizing.marked_equity_formula: settled_cash_equity + sum(side_sign * remaining_qty * (causal_mark - unslipped_reference_entry)) over open positions. Settled cash starts at 500 and includes every earlier realized reference-price PnL, fee, adverse slippage, signed funding and partial exactly once.
book_and_sizing.mark: Existing positions use the last checksum-verified 1h mark close with availability <= t; a same-open admission uses its unslipped reference open for same-open sizing, so its same-open unrealized PnL is zero.
book_and_sizing.risk_cash_formula: risk_cash = current marked side-book equity * 0.01 at each sequential entry attempt
book_and_sizing.gross_open_notional_formula: sum(abs(remaining_qty * causal_mark)) over positions open at the attempt; same-open admissions use unslipped reference open
book_and_sizing.leverage_notional_cap_formula: max(0, 10.0 * current marked side-book equity - current gross open notional); new notional may not exceed this cap before step flooring
book_and_sizing.entry_priority: Original filter-eligible weekly PIT CORE-20 order; later simultaneous attempts see earlier fills, costs, occupancy and leverage.
book_and_sizing.daily_halt_timezone: Africa/Cairo resolved per timestamp through the IANA timezone database
book_and_sizing.daily_halt: Freeze day-start marked equity at the first event in each Cairo day. Latch after an 8% loss before the first entry and after every cost, funding or exit event; block later new entries only, never exits or protection.
book_and_sizing.caller_override: forbidden; changing a formula or value creates new identities

costs_and_funding.funding: Checksum-verified actual Binance USD-M funding at every settlement t with entry_fill_time <= t < exit_fill_time, using the last causal verified mark.
costs_and_funding.funding_sign: signed_funding_cash = -signed_position_notional * funding_rate; positive rate debits long and credits short.
costs_and_funding.price_pnl_basis: Gross reference-price PnL uses unslipped reference fills only.
costs_and_funding.adverse_fill: Shift buys up and sells down by adverse slippage, round to the frozen tick against the strategy, charge fee on executable notional, and subtract slippage cash exactly once.
costs_and_funding.stress_rule: Run independent full causal books. Multiply fees, adverse slippage and negative funding debits; positive funding credits remain 1.0x. Repricing a fixed trade list is forbidden.

verdict_math.initial_risk_cash: initial_filled_quantity_after_leverage_cap_and_step_floor * R_price. Record requested risk separately; initial risk is immutable, finite and >0.
verdict_math.trade_r: episode_net_cash / initial_risk_cash, with reference-price PnL, signed funding, fees and adverse slippage across entry, partials and final exit counted exactly once
verdict_math.net_r: math.fsum(trade_r for every fully closed episode across wf1,wf2,wf3)
verdict_math.mean_r: net_r / closed_episode_count; zero episodes reports null and fails
verdict_math.profit_factor: math.fsum(positive trade_r) / abs(math.fsum(negative trade_r)); positive numerator with zero denominator is Infinity, otherwise zero denominator is 0
verdict_math.fold_net_r: math.fsum(trade_r) within each named fold; folds never pool to manufacture 2-of-3
verdict_math.cashflow_drawdown_r: Normalize every entry fee/slippage, funding settlement, partial PnL/fee/slippage and final PnL/fee/slippage cashflow by that episode's immutable initial_risk_cash. Within each fold sort event_time_ms ascending; math.fsum exact-timestamp cashflows atomically before updating cumulative R and peak. Peak starts 0; fold DD=max(peak-cumulative); promotion max_dd_r=max of three fold DDs, never a cross-fold curve.
verdict_math.marked_equity_drawdown: Report each fold maximum marked-equity cash and percentage drawdown after every frozen event phase and bar using causal marks; required disclosure, not a replacement for max_dd_r.
verdict_math.symbol_contribution: symbol_net_r=math.fsum(trade_r for that symbol); concentration=max(abs(symbol_net_r))/math.fsum(abs(symbol_net_r) for symbols with a close). Zero denominator reports 1.0 and fails; minimum symbols counts distinct symbols with a fully closed episode.
verdict_math.numeric_order: Use binary64 inputs and math.fsum. Sort folds by contract order, events by time and identity ties by symbol, entry_time_ms, immutable episode_id.
verdict_math.stress_replay: Run three independent full causal side books from 500 USDT at 1.0x, 1.5x, 2.0x. Recompute costs, cash, marked equity, sizing, step floors, leverage, halt, occupancy, admissions, exits and every metric; post-hoc fixed-trade repricing is forbidden.
verdict_math.promotion_cost_row: Base gates use the 1.0x replay. positive_after_1_5x_cost_stress means only 1.5x full-replay aggregate net_r > 0. The 2.0x replay is mandatory diagnostic disclosure.

statistics.role: required selection-bias diagnostics only; no raw, bootstrap or Holm value is a promotion gate

raw_p_value.test: one-sided Monte Carlo sign-flip test of after-cost net R versus zero
raw_p_value.unit: UTC calendar exit day; sum all fully closed episode trade_r on that day with math.fsum; omit days without a close
raw_p_value.formula: (1 + count(T_star >= T_observed)) / 100001; each resample independently multiplies every day unit by equiprobable -1 or +1; comparison is inclusive, including exact ties

bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.unit: UTC calendar exit-day cluster carrying that day's ordered trade_r values
bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.procedure: Sample observed exit-day clusters with replacement, preserving all trades and their order inside a selected day; replicate mean=math.fsum(sampled trade_r)/sampled trade count.
bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.interval: ordinary percentile [quantile(method=linear,0.025), quantile(method=linear,0.975)]; ties follow numpy linear interpolation; never Holm-adjusted
bootstrap_ci_95_mean_r.empty_sample: [null,null] with NO_CLOSED_EPISODES; cannot satisfy required-report or promotion gates

statistics.family_ledger: Validate the byte SHA256 and canonical content digest frozen in identity_and_multiplicity before market reads. Prior Stage-A long and short receive conservative raw p=1.0 when unavailable. Any later trial requires a new append-only ledger and contract identity.
statistics.holm_adjustment: For all m=4 trials, substitute 1.0 for unavailable prior p-values; sort (raw_p,trial_id) ascending. For j=1..m, adjusted_j=max over k<=j of min(1,(m-k+1)*raw_p_k), then map back to trial IDs. Exact p ties use trial_id ascending; report every raw/substituted and adjusted value.

promotion_gates_per_side.monthly_bucket_rule: Count closes in every UTC calendar month intersecting each fold, including zero-close months, before taking the median.
promotion_gates_per_side.regime_definition: BTC 4h close above/on versus below its causal EMA200 at the candidate decision candle

stop_conditions: Any contract, signal, management, authority or side-cell byte change creates new evaluation identities.
Any market/archive/outcome read before this contract is merged and validated refuses evaluation.
Any read at or after 2026-09-28T00:00:00Z refuses evaluation before evidence is produced.
Any use of future availability, current survivorship or future exchange rules refuses evaluation.
Any missing admitted-exposure evidence makes that whole side cell INCOMPLETE_CANDIDATE.
No result may weaken a gate, pool sides, select a fold, prune a symbol or tune a parameter.
